# Answer key: findings Procyon must report on APIs that are vulnerable on
# purpose. Format: <corpus name> <rule> <line>:<column> <METHOD /path>
#
# Only problems visible in the spec belong here. Many of these APIs'
# vulnerabilities live in their code (an undocumented field, a missing
# ownership check); finding those is the job of runtime tests (v0.2).
#
# When a rule lands, add the known problems it must find.

# VAmPI: GET /createdb resets the database and needs no authentication.
vampi PRC001 17:5 GET /createdb
# VAmPI: GET /users/v1/_debug dumps every user, passwords included, and
# needs no authentication.
vampi PRC001 89:5 GET /users/v1/_debug

# VAmPI: GET /users/v1/_debug returns every user's password.
vampi PRC005 114:25 GET /users/v1/_debug
# VAmPI: GET /books/v1/{book_title} returns the book's secret to any user.
vampi PRC005 620:21 GET /books/v1/{book_title}

# crAPI: deleting any user's video is an admin function any logged-in user
# can call (broken function level authorization).
crapi PRC010 855:7 DELETE /identity/api/v2/admin/videos/{video_id}
# crAPI: the workshop's management listing of all users, same problem.
crapi PRC010 2201:7 GET /workshop/api/management/users/all
